intro.text: A large suspension bridge carrying Elendel's outermost ring-road over the Irongate River.

description.text: Elendel's electric lighting stops short of the outskirts beyond the bridge.
Both a road and a railway cross it.

items.text: After meeting his uncle Edwarn, Waxillium Ladrian paused on the bridge to think, looking back over the city.
Chasing Bleeder, Wax caught up with her here, and their final fight played out on and around the bridge.
